verdicts.why: Episode 2: Katy and Shang-Chi meet Kamala's group at the New Orleans checkpoint and escape the Raft in the life pod with them. The last battle in Paris is Episode 4.
Episode 2: Zemo lets the groups aboard the Raft, ejects Kamala's cell to feed Namor, and escapes in the life pod with them. He is killed in New Asgard in Episode 3.
Episode 3: Valkyrie lets the group into New Asgard and flies the Commodore into space after Wanda's betrayal. She dies in the Paris battle in Episode 4.
Episode 4: the Masters of the Mystic Arts catch Kamala's group as they fall after the Nova Corps attack and bring them to Kamar-Taj, then lead them to Paris. They never meet Kamala before this.
Episode 4: Kamala wakes at Kamar-Taj and meets Spider-Man, then they fight in Paris. They never meet in Episodes 1 to 3.
Episode 4: the zombified Thor arrives in Paris and disintegrates Blade (Blade Knight page). In Episode 3 Thor is still alive and has no dealings with Blade.
Episode 2 opens with Shang-Chi and Katy fleeing San Francisco and surviving five years on the road. Neither appears in Episode 1, and Paris is Episode 4.

#8: after Ultron's nuclear holocaust Natasha and Clint are the only known survivors, outrunning his Sentries. She pierces his eye with the Zola arrow only in #9.
#8: Clint transfers Zola into a Sentry to invade Ultron's hive code, but it fails because Ultron has left their universe. Zola destroys Ultron and takes his body in #9.

Last scene of #7: as Thor leaves New Mexico, a portal opens and Ultron with all six Stones and his Sentries emerges before him. Thor drawing Ultron to the Guardians early and fighting him with Strange is #9.
